our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that dependable, consistently correct performance is uncommon across ordinary uses of generative AI.
Reliable does not mean flawless on every possible input, and rarely does not merely mean that some failures exist.
The sentence is broad, although the surrounding paragraph discusses copyright and source attribution.

For the ongoing state, January 1–24, 2024 is the latest pre-post month-to-date reporting window. Generative AI has no common reporting cycle; older evaluations are background rather than direct measurements of that window.
